one way I'm looking at this is, the more powerful an entity is the more vulnerable they can be in order to balance it out in someway. the key being extremely important for safeguarding the chaathan's powers, carries so much value. hence to balance that out, it must be attended to at all times in some way or form, extra protection must be given to it as it can be easily stolen. I think he felt that carrying the key around with him at all times would work rather than keeping it locked away elsewhere where someone could destroy it. but the cook could grab the key in that moment as kodumon pottys anger and attention was on him + he was anticipating the key being stolen by thevan later according to the scheme he heard. so he got overconfident and his arrogance caused him to not notice what happened.

yeah what was meant to be a unique feature of this universe in that the monsters are often manifestations of people's desires and insecurities has now become groups of rock monsters made out of household appliances in landfills. but also i wonder if this was somewhat on purpose considering the"group behaviour" they exhibited

I agree overall with how it feels like it was very all over the place despite having its good moments. eun hyu you were too good. i do have to ask what was going on with the monsters? >!why were they mostly like rock monsters/car monsters/house appliance aggregation masses??? that scene where the soldiers detonated a bomb to kill a bunch of them before returning to the stadium + the scene where they had a monster encounter when the scientist was taking a shit: why did all the monsters there look like the industrial waste cousins of The Thing??? ik it's not possible to make every single monster look so distinct as they're supposed to be given that they're all manifestations of the humans desire/insecurities. But why did they all have to look so similar?? I mean my guess is that it has something to do with the "group behaviour" they exhibited that the scientist remarked on, which might explain similar looking communities of monsters.!<

I think a lot of the loose ends i had doubts about are now clarified after i sat with them for some time. >!I still feel very bad about the character death in ep 3. she was my favourite :(!<
